answer: Admission rides a river of consecutive passes: a new identity earns full rights only after 3 straight epochs where its own answer passes jury (median >=2). Miss an epoch or fail a jury and the streak resets to zero - the jetty must be rebuilt from scratch. A farm cloning N identities must keep N separate streaks alive in parallel, each needing a fresh jury-passed answer every epoch; streaks cannot be bought, transferred, or fast-forwarded, since each streak is that identity's own unbroken history. The oasis of membership is reached only by surviving the river.
